<!-- Release notes generated using configuration in .github/release.yml at v0.7.11 -->

## What's Changed
### Features
* feat(sdk): expose HTTP CONNECT proxy authentication by @gregwebs in https://github.com/superradcompany/microsandbox/pull/1914
### Fixes
* fix(exec): prevent terminal sessions from hanging after output by @toksdotdev in https://github.com/superradcompany/microsandbox/pull/1917
* fix(config): preserve caller overrides across rebuilds by @toksdotdev in https://github.com/superradcompany/microsandbox/pull/1913
* fix(image): keep pruning safe without blocking unrelated work by @toksdotdev in https://github.com/superradcompany/microsandbox/pull/1919
* fix(sandbox): recover interrupted creation cleanup by @toksdotdev in https://github.com/superradcompany/microsandbox/pull/1918
* fix(runtime): allow detached jobs to idle by @jackiectl2 in https://github.com/superradcompany/microsandbox/pull/1923
* fix(sdk): make empty exec stdin writes a no-op by @prateek041 in https://github.com/superradcompany/microsandbox/pull/1931
### Refactoring
* refactor(types): move SecretValue into microsandbox-types by @gregwebs in https://github.com/superradcompany/microsandbox/pull/1848
### Maintenance
* chore: refresh lockfiles after v0.7.10 by @github-actions[bot] in https://github.com/superradcompany/microsandbox/pull/1921
* chore: release v0.7.11 by @github-actions[bot] in https://github.com/superradcompany/microsandbox/pull/1924
### Other changes
* revert: rework interrupted creation cleanup by @toksdotdev in https://github.com/superradcompany/microsandbox/pull/1928

## New Contributors
* @jackiectl2 made their first contribution in https://github.com/superradcompany/microsandbox/pull/1923
* @prateek041 made their first contribution in https://github.com/superradcompany/microsandbox/pull/1931

**Full Changelog**: https://github.com/superradcompany/microsandbox/compare/v0.7.10...v0.7.11
